name: MKTG 310 prose-only deadlines
text:
MKTG 310 — Consumer Behavior
Fall 2026, Tuesdays and Thursdays 2:00–3:15 PM, Business Hall 220
Professor Elena Marsh · emarsh@school.edu · Office hours by appointment

Welcome! This course explores why people buy what they buy. We will draw on
psychology, sociology, and economics to understand how consumers search for,
evaluate, purchase, and dispose of products and services.

How you will be evaluated
Your grade is built from four components. Two individual application papers are
worth 15% each. A team brand audit is worth 30%, split between a written report
and a final presentation. The midterm exam counts for 20%, and the remaining 20%
comes from weekly reading reflections and in-class participation.

Key deadlines
The first application paper is due by Friday, September 18, at 11:59 PM. We will
hold the midterm exam in class on Thursday, October 15. Your team should submit a
one-page brand audit proposal by Tuesday, October 6. The second application paper
is due by Friday, October 30. Brand audit presentations take place in class on
December 1 and December 3; the written brand audit report is due Monday, December 7.

Reading reflections
Short reflections (300 words) are due before class every Tuesday starting
September 1. They are graded complete/incomplete.

Course schedule overview
Weeks 1-3: Consumer decision making
Weeks 4-6: Perception, learning, and memory
Weeks 7-8: Motivation, personality, and lifestyle
Weeks 9-11: Attitudes and persuasion
Weeks 12-14: Groups, culture, and digital consumers
Week 15: Brand audit presentations

Policies
Late papers lose one letter grade per day. Laptops are welcome for note-taking.
If you need accommodations, please reach out during the first two weeks.
notes: Presentation slot (Dec 1 or Dec 3) is ambiguous and excluded; weekly reflections recur and are excluded.
